body.condition: Every continuous mechanism, categorical propensity coordinate, district-density piece, and query integrand supplied to the certificate program is represented by a finite \(\Gamma_{\mathrm{rat}}\) expression and obeys its declared range and Lipschitz bound.

novel.justification: Rational ReLU networks, piecewise-polynomial density models, and polynomial welfare functionals cover standard auditable structural specifications while retaining exact finite descriptions.
